# AWS Resource Explorer

Search TinyStack inventory using regional indexes and views.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `resourceexplorer2` |
| Signing name | `resource-explorer-2` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2022-07-28` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Live regional inventory search; records-only control plane |
| Selected operations | 20 of 32 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-resource-explorer) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- AGGREGATOR is stored and uniqueness is enforced, but searches remain confined to the index Region because listing.Scoped is regional. Global inventory resources are visible only from us-east-1.
- Managed views, organization/cross-account scopes, account-level service configuration, setup, streams and newer operations are not implemented. Scope supports only the caller account root ARN.
- No asynchronous indexing, replication, service-linked role creation, or 24-hour aggregator promotion cooldown; searches read live inventory. No relevance ranking or AWS-wide supported-type catalogue.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.
